items.title: 'Complete system reset' needed to get 440,000 young people into work, says major review
items.summary: Alan Milburn's review will call for sweeping reforms to the education, work and welfare systems.

items.title: The young people caught up in Britain's Neets crisis
items.summary: BBC News speaks to four of the million young people aged 16 to 24 who are not in work, education or training.

items.title: Robert Pattinson to replace Daniel Craig as James Bond
items.summary: The 40-year old is best known for his role in films including Twilight, The Batman and The Odyssey.

items.title: Cass report author says she does not support draft conversion practices bill

items.title: Forensic expert says his analysis of autopsy photos suggests Epstein was killed
items.summary: Professor Michael Freeman tells BBC Newsnight that he believes the convicted sex offender's injuries are consistent with a homicide.

items.title: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war

items.title: Met Office yellow warning in place as snow could disrupt Tuesday morning travel
items.summary: Snow could bring some transport disruption to the hills of northern England and southern Scotland, as Chris Fawkes explains.
